families.page_title: Infection prevention and control guidelines for adult prisons
evidence_points: Vaccination history should be checked and eligible people offered vaccination.
Arrival and transfer processes should include health-risk assessment and screening.
Standard precautions include hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, PPE, cleaning, linen, waste and sharps management.
Transmission-based precautions are added for known or suspected infections.
Isolation and precaution decisions should reflect infectivity, clinical advice and prison-specific risk.
Infection or multidrug-resistant-organism status should be included in safe discharge and handover planning.

families.page_title: Managing flu, COVID-19 and other acute respiratory infections (ARI) in prisons and other prescribed places of detention (PPDs)
evidence_points: The guidance covers flu, COVID-19 and other acute respiratory infections in adult detention.
Eligible residents and staff should be supported to access flu, COVID-19 and RSV vaccination.
An ARI outbreak is defined as 2 or more epidemiologically linked cases within 5 days.
Suspected outbreaks should be reported to the health protection team for risk assessment.
Testing in outbreaks may use multiplex PCR on a limited number of linked recent-onset cases.
Control measures should balance transmission reduction with health, wellbeing and operational impacts.

evidence_points: The resource provides general IPC principles for adult social care in England.
